errors.name: Connection Pool Exhaustion
errors.signature: connection pool exhausted|unable to acquire connection
errors.description: Application cannot acquire a database connection within the configured wait period.

errors.name: Request Timeout
errors.description: A request exceeded its configured response deadline.

errors.name: Kafka Consumer Lag
errors.description: A consumer group is processing events slower than producers publish them.

errors.name: Database Deadlock
errors.description: Concurrent transactions hold locks in conflicting order.

errors.name: Dependency Failure
errors.description: A service cannot complete an operation because a downstream dependency is unhealthy.

errors.name: Database Latency
errors.description: Database operations take longer than expected.

errors.name: Retry Amplification
errors.description: Retries increase load or backlog during a failure.

errors.name: Cache Inconsistency
errors.description: Cached data does not reflect the latest source-of-truth state.

errors.name: Event Schema Incompatibility
errors.description: Producer and consumer disagree on an event schema.

errors.name: Duplicate Event Processing
errors.description: An event is processed more than once without effective idempotency.
